title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New Stage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This should be the stage where MEIKO and Rin are putting on their show.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And I'm in luck. KAITO's with them. They should be starting their rehearsal any—)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehe, time to commence Operation Gratitude Repayment♪)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Their dancing is so lovely!
That choreography is adorable. Alright, I need to note these down...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Ooh... So close!
They were just a smidgen off-time. I'll write that down too...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Good work, MEIKO, Rin!
Let's take five.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Here, take these drinks.
They're good for fatigue. Those towels just there are for you too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe, KAITO.
I see that you have your own special drink today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right here.
There's a sticky note that says “KAITO's Special Drink”.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO, there's a notepad on top of the towels. Is it yours?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whoa, it's full of notes about the song we just did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're right... But, this isn't mine.
I didn't have time to take notes while I was checking the sound and lighting...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wonder if they noticed the notes and the drink. I hope it helps even just a little bit♪)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, you two♪
Let's do our best in today's practice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's.
We found a few different areas for improvement last time, so we gotta work through them one by one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of that, I wrote them all out on this sheet of paper so it's easier to grasp.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow...!
You've drawn up two whole tables for singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I figured this would make it easier to get an overview of our problem areas.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, what are these squares next to each of the issues?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those are spots to attach “Fantastic Job Flowers”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Each issue we cross off will earn us a new flower until finally, the whole sheet is a field of blossoms!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll need to work hard to make this sheet bloom, then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, KAITO?
And MEIKO and Rin too?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, we still have more to go. But we wanted to say thank you first.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, thank you for writing all those notes about where we were doing well and where we need to improve♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You figured out it was me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for my special drink too. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that cute blush.
Do you mind explaining what happened?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember how I caused everyone to worry during my solo training the other day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: After that, I wanted to show my gratitude by being helpful to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So the reason you made those tables was...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanted to contribute what I could to make our show a success.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to say thank you too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My hands have been full during rehearsal, and I've been unable to focus on the singing and dancing, despite them being the main event. So, thank you so much for your detailed notes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're gonna use them to make the rest of our rehearsal even better! Thanks so much!
